task: Fix inconsistent JSX ordering in IndexType form components so IntegrationSection always appears after FormAutocomplete (embeddingsModel) across all Datasource Types.

key_reasoning.reason: Six IndexType components require changes (IndexTypeJira, IndexTypeConfluence, IndexTypeXray, IndexTypeAzureDevOpsWorkItem, IndexTypeAzureDevOpsWiki, IndexTypeSharePoint) with a possible seventh (IndexTypeGoogle pending scope confirmation). All files are in the same directory — src/pages/dataSources/components/DataSourceForm/IndexTypeField/. No new files are created.

Multiple leaf form components touched but all within the same directory and the same presentation layer. No shared utility, store, hook, or API layer involvement. The IntegrationSection shared component itself is not modified.

Task description is explicit with a named reference implementation (IndexTypeGit/IndexTypeSvn). One minor open question exists: whether IndexTypeGoogle is in scope (its layout is architecturally different — OAuth integration intentionally precedes other fields). This is a lightweight clarification, not a blocker.
